title: Nashville Getaway | 3BR + Large Fenced Yard
description:
Our spacious 3-bedroom home has room for everyone, a cozy modern vibe, and all the essentials you need for a memorable stay. Perfect for families and groups, you’ll enjoy comfortable bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, and inviting living spaces to relax after exploring Music City.

🌿 What makes this home special:

Very large backyard with an 8’ privacy fence — ideal for gatherings, games, or simply relaxing outdoors. (Potential for party rental in the future!)

The space
Bring the whole crew! This comfy 3-bedroom home has plenty of space for families or groups.

🛏 Sleeping Arrangements:

1 King Bed
1 Queen Bed
2 Twin Beds
2 Bunk Beds

🍳 Fully equipped kitchen
🛋 Cozy living + dining areas
🌳 Bright windows & natural light

Close to dining, shopping, and all the Music City fun. Whether you’re here for a getaway, family trip, or just to explore, this is the perfect spot to relax after a day out.

Book your stay and make memories in Nashville! 🎶

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire home.

Other things to note
THINGS TO KNOW

- Streaming is available using your own accounts.
- Guest entry instructions: This rental utilizes a smart lock that requires a unique code to enter. This code is reset after each guest's stay.
